home.headline: Let your Life flow
home.subheadline: Thoughtfully made mattresses and sleep products from Synnera Mattress LLP.
home.body: Synnera is a mattress manufacturing brand based in Rajkot, Gujarat, serving customers across India with a range of foam, spring and specialty sleep products.

about.title: A focused mattress manufacturing brand from Rajkot
about.body: Established in 2019, Synnera Mattress LLP develops and manufactures mattresses and sleep accessories from its facility in Rajkot, Gujarat. Our focus is on creating practical, comfortable and well-presented sleep products for the Indian market.

productsIntro.title: Sleep solutions for different comfort preferences
productsIntro.body: Synnera manufactures a broad range of mattress constructions, along with selected sleep accessories. Product specifications, fabrics, sizes and configurations can be customized for suitable B2B requirements.

products.title: Pocket Spring Mattresses
products.description: Pocket spring construction designed around responsive support and reduced partner disturbance.

products.title: Memory Foam Mattresses
products.description: Memory foam mattresses focused on contouring, pressure relief and motion dampening.

products.title: Orthopedic Mattresses
products.description: Support-oriented mattress constructions designed around balanced comfort and body support.

products.title: Natural Latex Mattresses
products.description: Latex mattress solutions with resilient support, airflow and pressure-point comfort.

products.title: Luxury Foam Mattresses
products.description: Soft, lightweight foam mattress options designed for comfortable everyday sleep.

products.title: Sleep Accessories
products.description: Supporting sleep products including pillows, mattress chain covers and mattress protectors.

manufacturing.title: Built around a focused manufacturing operation
manufacturing.body: Synnera operates from a 5,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility in Rajkot, Gujarat, with a stated production capacity of up to 5,000 mattresses per month. The facility supports mattress development and production workflows for quality-focused B2B and retail needs.

steps.title: Material selection
steps.text: Materials are selected according to the intended mattress construction and product requirement.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: Foam, spring and specialty layers are assembled according to the specified design.

steps.title: Finishing
steps.text: Mattresses are finished with their specified fabrics, covers and supporting components.

steps.title: Quality check
steps.text: Finished products are reviewed before packing and dispatch.

capabilities.title: Manufacturing that can adapt to your requirements
capabilities.body: Synnera supports OEM, private-label and bulk manufacturing requirements, with options for customized sizes, firmness, fabrics, branding and packaging.
